scope: Read-only GSG formulation and current DLW SD implementation comparison; no numerical recomputation or report edit

paper.tau_role: bilinear construction and analytic soliton reference / initialization

current_dlw.unknowns: F_j,G_j; stored as logarithms, solved as new/old tau ratios
current_dlw.initial_fields: common physical u,v obtained by discrete lift
current_dlw.counterexample: For F=exp(k*x), D1(F)/F=sinh(k*dx)/dx whereas D1(log F)=k
current_dlw.raw_bilinear_residual_meaning: accuracy of solving the stated tau-discretized equations; not equivalence to the nonlinear discrete system or proof of full-discrete integrability

conclusion: A direct bilinear tau scheme is a legitimate separate numerical route; reproducing GSG methodology requires advancing the nonlinear DLW semi-discrete system and aligning time integration/comparison conditions.
